visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a hand holding a stacked dessert, specifically a thick-filled dacquoise, against a blurry outdoor market background with bright daylight. (2) A shot of a hand using a toothpick to pick up a sample-sized piece of the dessert from a white plastic container filled with many sample pieces. (3) The camera shows two individually packaged dacquoise sandwiches held up against a clear blue sky, one with a shell pattern and the other round. (4) Close-up shots show hands breaking open various dacquoises to reveal their colorful and textured fillings, including a dark tea-colored center, a white stretchy mochi layer, and light green pistachio paste with whole nuts. (5) A heart-shaped dacquoise with pink cream is split open, revealing a dark red jam center. (6) Another dacquoise with yellow cream and orange fruit pieces is shown being split apart. (7) The camera pans across a glass display case at a market stall, labeled with the brand name, containing many packaged desserts. (8) A female vendor wearing a face mask and a black t-shirt hands a brown paper bag with a logo to a customer. (9) A close-up of the brown paper bag held up in the market, with various promotional text overlays appearing on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial promotion for a specific dessert brand, '與絃相遇 Dessert'. It aims to entice viewers by showcasing the visual appeal and diverse flavors of their thick-filled dacquoise sandwiches, highlighting the variety and quality of ingredients before providing information on how to purchase them at local markets or via delivery.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on one brand, features its logo on the product packaging and bag, and provides social media information for finding their market stall.
